subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, an in-TUI setting, or a changed CLI default with explicit opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is source-verifiable, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs frame delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the chosen canonical delivery-default surface with schema, help, docs, tests, and explicit CLI flag precedence.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave `--deliver` as an intentional per-session flag and close or document the ergonomics request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Change default behavior
options.body: Make delivery on by default with an opt-out only if maintainers accept the compatibility and message-delivery behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the chosen canonical delivery-default surface with schema, help, docs, tests, and explicit CLI flag precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI command/runtime surface and most relevant history point to `steipete`, and this is mainly a product/default contract decision.
